inference: Because process_one_work clears PENDING before calling the work function, schedule_work may queue one follow-up execution while the current worker runs; additional notifications coalesce while that follow-up is pending. The GV100 teardown first blocks and removes a wait=true notifier whose callback is protected by the event-list read lock, then flushes work before releasing the buffer.
limitations: Upstream Linux source analysis only; Ubuntu module source-package equivalence is unknown.
